        How to: Create Screen Parts
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Shared
 > How to: Create Screen Parts
    
    
    
        Screen parts simply represent a portion of an overall web page. Screen parts are represented by the SCREEN_PART database table. There can be 1-N screen parts (ordered by SEQUENCE field) for a particular page. Screen parts are tied to screens through the MAIN_UI_SCREEN table (SCREEN_PART.SCREEN_ID = MAIN_UI_SCREEN.OBJECT_ID).


     Step 1: Determine the Object Id for the screen



    Use the following SQL to determine the Object Id for the screen if you know the Form Id. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                
                    Find the Object Id for screen

                    
                        
                            Copy Code
                        
                    
                

                
                    
                        
select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = <form id>

                    
                
            
        
    



     Step 2: Create screen part record



    Create a new record in the SCREEN_PART table tied to the corresponding MAIN_UI_SCREEN record for the page. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                Field

                Description/Notes
            

            
                PART_NAME

                The name of the screen part. For insight screens, the search pane must be named "SearchPane", the list pane must be named "ListPane", the detail pane must be named "DetailPane".
            

            
                RESOURCE_KEY

                The resource key of the text to show for the screen part, if any.
            

            
                PART_TYPE

                The type of the part. Please see the "Screen Part Type" configuration for an enumeration of all screen part types.
            

            
                SEQUENCE

                Screen parts are rendered in sequence order.
            

            
                DEFAULT_ACTION

                The button or link that should be triggered when the Enter key is pressed and focus is in a control within this screen part. Please see the How to: Set Default Action for Enter Key topic for more details.
            

            
                DIV_CSS_CLASS

                Used to configure the layout of the screen part. Please see the How to: Configure Layout of Metadata Pages topic for more details.
            

            
                PARTIAL_VIEW

                Whether the screen part should be rendered as a partial view. Currently only Modal Dialogs support partial views.
            
        
           

    
        Please note that the dbc_IScreenPart stored procedure can be used to create screen parts.
    

    

            
            See Also

Screen parts simply represent a portion of an overall web page. Screen parts are represented by the SCREEN_PART database table. There can be 1-N screen parts (ordered by SEQUENCE field) for a particular page. Screen parts are tied to screens through the MAIN_UI_SCREEN table (SCREEN_PART.SCREEN_ID = MAIN_UI_SCREEN.OBJECT_ID).




     Step 1: Determine the Object Id for the screen





    
Use the following SQL to determine the Object Id for the screen if you know the Form Id. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).


    

        

            

                

                    
Find the Object Id for screen


                    

                        

                            Copy Code
                        

                    

                


                

                    

                        

select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = <form id>


                    

                

            

        

    






     Step 2: Create screen part record





    
Create a new record in the SCREEN_PART table tied to the corresponding MAIN_UI_SCREEN record for the page. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).




    

        

            

                
Field


                
Description/Notes

            


            

                
PART_NAME


                
The name of the screen part. For insight screens, the search pane must be named "SearchPane", the list pane must be named "ListPane", the detail pane must be named "DetailPane".

            


            

                
RESOURCE_KEY


                
The resource key of the text to show for the screen part, if any.

            


            

                
PART_TYPE


                
The type of the part. Please see the "Screen Part Type" configuration for an enumeration of all screen part types.

            


            

                
SEQUENCE


                
Screen parts are rendered in sequence order.

            


            

                
DEFAULT_ACTION


                
The button or link that should be triggered when the Enter key is pressed and focus is in a control within this screen part. Please see the How to: Set Default Action for Enter Key topic for more details.

            


            

                
DIV_CSS_CLASS


                
Used to configure the layout of the screen part. Please see the How to: Configure Layout of Metadata Pages topic for more details.

            


            

                
PARTIAL_VIEW


                
Whether the screen part should be rendered as a partial view. Currently only Modal Dialogs support partial views.

            

        

    
       

    

        Please note that the dbc_IScreenPart stored procedure can be used to create screen parts.
